scientific_integrity: A single boundary theorem about covariance of categorical sample richness and unbiased pairwise Gini–Simpson diversity; all mathematical cases are proved using deterministic count bounds, elementary covariance, and two-component mixture conditioning; direct rational computation corroborates the explicit counterexample.
scientific_limitations: The finite-exchangeability counterexample need not extend to an infinite sequence.
The infinitely exchangeable three-label mixture is negative at sample size 22, but minimality of 22 among infinite mixtures is not asserted.
Historical priority may be affected by an unlocated older presentation using occupancy, evenness or exchangeability terminology.
title: Sharp exchangeability boundaries for richness–pair-diversity covariance
